report:
All 58 windows are graded and stored (52 accepted in the first batch, then 6 accepted after fixing refs that fell outside each window's allowed time range). The last step, `label get judgment --intent test_turn_then_brake`, crashes. That's not caused by this job: two other shards, `ep-l1x_dream_recover_person_present.jsonl` and `ex-l1x_dream_recover_person_present-j1.jsonl`, both label `GDC_Library_42:0297`. It needs a priority entry in `labels/precedence.json`. I checked the shard `annotations/labels/judgment/l2-test_turn_then_brake-v9-p1.jsonl` directly: it has 58 rows.

**Episodes found.** A turn is at least 45° within 3 s; a brake is at least a 30% drop in smoothed speed within 5 s of the turn starting. I used the turn start as each episode's anchor.

| Recording | Turn | Brake |
|---|---|---|
| GDC_Library_42 | left from ~3.7 s, +80° | 1.03→0.37 m/s by 7.04 s (−64%) |
| GDC_Library_42 | left from ~27.8 s, about +70° | 0.94→0.08 m/s by 31.31 s (−92%) |
| GDC_Library_42 | left from 31.74 s, about +75° | 0.80→0.17 m/s over 32.84–33.93 s (−79%) |
| GDC_Library_42 | right from ~45.6 s, −65° | 0.72→0.14 m/s by 46.83 s (−80%) |
| GDC_Library_42 | right from 48.17 s, −62° | 0.88→0.15 m/s by 49.51 s (−83%) |
| GDC_Library_42 | right from ~49.9 s, −47.4° within 2.65 s (only just qualifies) | ~0.65→0.23 m/s by 51.26 s (−65%) |
| JCL | left from 28.45 s, +65.5° by 31.35 s | 1.01→0.38 m/s over 28.71–29.91 s (−63%) |

GDC_Library_42 also has a turn at ~23.8 s followed by a 47% drop, but none of the listed windows contain it.

**Near misses (graded 0):**
- **GDC_Library_42:0084:** a −143° turn from 79.06 s, but the speed only drops 0.90→0.64 m/s, which is 29.2%.
- **JCL:0084:** a 54% brake by 83.71 s, but the gradual turn reaches only about 39° in any 3 s.
- **Bass_Garage_134:**
  - Early turns (+54° at 34–37 s) are followed by speed rising.
  - Later brakes (at about 52 s, 75 s and 83 s) have no turn before them. After 50 s the heading never moves more than 35.6°.

**Grade counts:** 15 × 2, 43 × 0, no 1s and no −1s.
- The 2s are GDC_Library_42 0004, 0006, 0031–0036 and 0048–0053, plus JCL:0029.
- GDC, Library_Fountain_5, Library_Jester_75, Library_MLK and GDC_Library_42's later windows show no qualifying turn, and mostly steady speed.

**What the data can't establish:** nothing; every part of this intent is computed from odometry. The one judgement call is the word "then". In JCL at 28.45 s and GDC_Library_42 at 48.17 s, the slowdown begins within about 0.3 s of the turn starting, so turning and braking largely overlap. I counted them because the drop happens after the turn starts. A stricter rule, requiring the brake to begin after the turn has reached 45°, would downgrade those windows.
